Based on the provided text, it appears that the OpenCV library version that supports the Mask-RCNN model is 3.4.3. This information can be found in the text snippet:

"...The minimum required version of OpenCV is 3.4.3."

Additionally, the text mentions that the Mask-RCNN model was first introduced in November 2017 by Facebook's AI Research team using Python and Caffe2. This information can be found in the text snippet:

"...[Mask-RCNN] was initially introduced in Nov 2017 by Facebook’s AI Research team using [Python and Caffe2](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Detectron)."

As for the contributor with the same name as a former Chinese head of government when the names are transliterated to the Latin alphabet, the text does not provide a direct answer. However, it does mention that the contributor list for the version of OpenCV where support for the Mask-RCNN model was first introduced is not provided in the text snippet.
